original_ai_output.title_zh: 英国一名地方议员因呼吁“熔化”尼日利亚人被判有罪
original_ai_output.summary_zh: 英国法院裁定桑德兰市议员格伦·吉宾斯有罪，原因是他在Facebook发帖称应将尼日利亚人“熔化”以填补路面坑洞。据Chronicle Live报道，这名66岁的前改革英国党议员在南泰恩赛德治安法院经三小时审理后被判有罪，判处12个月社区令并从事150小时无偿劳动。他承认言论具有冒犯性，但否认属于“严重冒犯”。该帖发布于2024年3月。

location.raw_text: Sunderland / South Tyneside Magistrates' Court, United Kingdom

key_facts.fact: 英国法院裁定桑德兰市议员格伦·吉宾斯因针对当地尼日利亚社区的言论有罪
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: A United Kingdom court has convicted a 66-year-old Sunderland councillor, Glenn Gibbins, over “grossly offensive” comments he made about the city’s Nigerian community.

key_facts.fact: 吉宾斯被判处12个月社区令并从事150小时无偿劳动
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: sentenced him to a 12-month community order with 150 hours of unpaid work

key_facts.fact: 相关言论发布于2024年3月的Facebook帖子
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: He made the remarks in a Facebook post in March 2024.

key_facts.fact: 他承认言论具有冒犯性，但否认属于严重冒犯
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: Gibbins was said to have admitted that his comments were offensive but denied that they were grossly so.

uncertainties: 目前仅有一个来源（Punch，引述Chronicle Live报道），尚缺乏交叉验证
报道未提供判决日期等细节
